shortDescription: DCNM Ansible Module for managing Service Route Peerings.

options.name: attach
options.description: A flag specifying if the given route peering is to be attached to the specified service node

options.name: config
options.description: A list of dictionaries containing route peering and switch information

options.name: deploy
options.description: A flag specifying if a route peering is to be deployed on the switches

options.name: fabric
options.description: Name of the target fabric for route peering operations

options.name: service_fabric
options.description: Name of the external fabric attached to the service node for route peering operations

options.name: state
options.description: The required state of the configuration after module completion.
